mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE T ( ID, NAME, parent_id, PATH ) AS ( SELECT ID,NAME,PARENT_ID,ID::text AS PATH FROM sys_department WHERE parent_id = '0' UNION ALL SELECT st.ID,st.NAME,st.PARENT_ID,T.PATH ||','|| st.ID FROM sys_department st JOIN T ON st.PARENT_ID = T.ID ) SELECT ID,NAME,PARENT_ID,PATH FROM T ORDER BY PATH;
